New issue 86 by astuka...@gmail.com: rstan makefile doesn't respect R_HOME
http://code.google.com/p/stan/issues/detail?id=86

If R_HOME is defined, rstan makefile script should use this R installation.

Currently it uses R/Rscript that are on PATH.
However, Rscript checks if R_HOME variable matches its own location and
issues a warning if not. This warning gets into RSTANVER and STANPKG and
the makefile execution fails (':' inside RSTANVER causes 'multiple targets'
error).

The correct behaviour would be to call R/RScript from R_HOME, if it's
defined, since it's also something that user would expect.

Attached is the quick fix to this problem.

Attachments:
0001-use-R-from-R_HOME-when-it-s-defined.patch 1.1 KB
